doc.brief: Asynchronous API to present a file chooser dialog.
doc.md:
Asynchronous API to present a file chooser dialog.

`GtkFileDialog` collects the arguments that are needed to present
the dialog to the user, such as a title for the dialog and whether
it should be modal.

The dialog is shown with [`FileDialog.open()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:open),
[`FileDialog.save()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:save), etc.

get_accept_label.md: Retrieves the text used by the dialog on its accept button.

get_default_filter.brief: Gets the filter that will be selected by default in the file chooser dialog.
get_default_filter.md:
Gets the filter that will be selected by default
in the file chooser dialog.

get_filters.md:
Gets the filters that will be offered to the user
in the file chooser dialog.

get_initial_file.brief: Gets the file that will be initially selected in the file chooser dialog.
get_initial_file.md:
Gets the file that will be initially selected in
the file chooser dialog.

get_initial_folder.brief: Gets the folder that will be set as the initial folder in the file chooser dialog.
get_initial_folder.md:
Gets the folder that will be set as the

get_initial_name.md: Gets the filename that will be initially selected.

get_modal.md:
Returns whether the file chooser dialog blocks interaction

get_title.brief: Returns the title that will be shown on the file chooser dialog.
get_title.md: Returns the title that will be shown on the file chooser dialog.

open.brief: Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.
open.md:
Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.

The file chooser dialog will be set up to select a single file.

The `callback` will be called when the dialog is closed.

open_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileDialog.open()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:open) call.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

open_multiple.brief: Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.
open_multiple.md:
Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.

The file chooser dialog will be set up to select multiple files.

The file chooser dialog will initially be opened in the directory
[`FileDialog:initial-folder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:initial-folder).

The `callback` will be called when the dialog is closed.

open_multiple_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileDialog.open()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:open) call.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

open_multiple_text_files.brief: Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.
open_multiple_text_files.md:
Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.

The file chooser dialog will be set up to select multiple files.

The file chooser dialog will initially be opened in the directory
[`FileDialog:initial-folder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:initial-folder).

In contrast to [`FileDialog.open()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:open), this function
lets the user select the text encoding for the files, if possible.

The `callback` will be called when the dialog is closed.

open_multiple_text_files_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileDialog.open()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:open) call.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

open_text_file.brief: Initiates a file selection operation by presenting a file chooser dialog to the user.
open_text_file.md:
Initiates a file selection operation by presenting a file chooser
dialog to the user.

In contrast to [`FileDialog.open()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:open), this function
lets the user select the text encoding for the file, if possible.

The `callback` will be called when the dialog is closed.

open_text_file_finish.brief: Finishes the [`FileDialog.open_text_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:open_text_file) call and returns the resulting file and text encoding.
open_text_file_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileDialog.open_text_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:open_text_file) call
and returns the resulting file and text encoding.

If the user has explicitly selected a text encoding to use
for the file, then `encoding` will be set to a codeset name that
is suitable for passing to iconv_open(). Otherwise, it will
be `NULL`.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

save.brief: Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.
save.md:
Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.

The file chooser dialog will be save mode.

The `callback` will be called when the dialog is closed.

save_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileDialog.save()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:save) call.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

save_text_file.brief: Initiates a file save operation by presenting a file chooser dialog to the user.
save_text_file.md:
Initiates a file save operation by presenting a file chooser
dialog to the user.

In contrast to [`FileDialog.save()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:save), this function
lets the user select the text encoding and line endings for
the text file, if possible.

The `callback` will be called when the dialog is closed.

save_text_file_finish.brief: Finishes the [`FileDialog.save_text_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:save_text_file) call and returns the resulting file, text encoding and line endings.
save_text_file_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileDialog.save_text_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:save_text_file) call
and returns the resulting file, text encoding and line endings.

If the user has explicitly selected a text encoding to use
for the file, then `encoding` will be set to a codeset name that
is suitable for passing to iconv_open(). Otherwise, it will
be `NULL`.

The `line_ending` will be set to one of "\n", "\r\n", "\r" or "",
where the latter means to preserve existing line endings.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

select_folder.brief: Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.
select_folder.md:
Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.

The file chooser dialog will be set up to select a single folder.

If you pass `initial_folder`, the file chooser dialog will initially
be opened in the parent directory of that folder, otherwise, it
will be in the directory [`FileDialog:initial-folder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:initial-folder).

The `callback` will be called when the dialog is closed.

select_folder_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileDialog.select_folder()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:select_folder) call.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

select_multiple_folders.brief: Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.
select_multiple_folders.md:
Presents a file chooser dialog to the user.

The file chooser dialog will be set up to allow selecting
multiple folders.

The file chooser dialog will initially be opened in the
directory [`FileDialog:initial-folder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:initial-folder).

The `callback` will be called when the dialog is closed.

select_multiple_folders_finish.md:
Finishes the [`FileDialog.select_multiple_folders()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:select_multiple_folders) call.

Note that this function returns a [`DISMISSED`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DialogError.DISMISSED)
error if the user cancels the dialog.

set_accept_label.brief: Sets the label shown on the file chooser's accept button.
set_accept_label.md:
Sets the label shown on the file chooser's accept button.

Leaving the accept label unset or setting it as `NULL` will
fall back to a default label, depending on what API is used
to launch the file dialog.

set_default_filter.brief: Sets the filter that will be selected by default in the file chooser dialog.
set_default_filter.md:
Sets the filter that will be selected by default
in the file chooser dialog.

If set to `NULL`, the first item in [`FileDialog:filters`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:filters)
will be used as the default filter. If that list is empty, the dialog
will be unfiltered.

set_filters.brief: Sets the filters that will be offered to the user in the file chooser dialog.
set_filters.md:
Sets the filters that will be offered to the user
in the file chooser dialog.

set_initial_file.brief: Sets the file that will be initially selected in the file chooser dialog.
set_initial_file.md:
Sets the file that will be initially selected in
the file chooser dialog.

This function is a shortcut for calling both
[`FileDialog.set_initial_folder()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:set_initial_folder) and
[`FileDialog.set_initial_name()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#method:set_initial_name) with the
directory and name of `file`, respectively.

set_initial_folder.brief: Sets the folder that will be set as the initial folder in the file chooser dialog.
set_initial_folder.md:
Sets the folder that will be set as the
initial folder in the file chooser dialog.

set_initial_name.brief: Sets the filename that will be initially selected.
set_initial_name.md:
Sets the filename that will be initially selected.

For save dialogs, `name` will usually be pre-entered into the
name field.

If a file with this name already exists in the directory set
via [`FileDialog:initial-folder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:initial-folder), the dialog will
preselect it.

set_modal.brief: Sets whether the file chooser dialog blocks interaction with the parent window while it is presented.
set_modal.md:
Sets whether the file chooser dialog blocks interaction
with the parent window while it is presented.

set_title.brief: Sets the title that will be shown on the file chooser dialog.
set_title.md: Sets the title that will be shown on the file chooser dialog.

accept-label.brief: Label for the file chooser's accept button.
accept-label.md: Label for the file chooser's accept button.

default-filter.md:
The default filter.

This filter is initially active in the file chooser dialog.

If the default filter is `NULL`, the first filter of [`FileDialog:filters`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:filters)
is used as the default filter. If that property contains no filter, the dialog will
be unfiltered.

If [`FileDialog:filters`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:filters) is not `NULL`, the default filter should be
part of the list. If it is not, the dialog may choose to not make it available.

filters.md:
The list of filters.

See [`FileDialog:default-filter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:default-filter) about how these
two properties interact.

initial-file.md:
The initial file.

This file is initially selected in the file chooser dialog

This is a utility property that sets both [`FileDialog:initial-folder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:initial-folder)
and [`FileDialog:initial-name`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FileDialog#property:initial-name).

initial-folder.md:
The initial folder.

This is the directory that is initially opened in the file chooser dialog.

initial-name.md:
The initial name.

This is the name of the file that is initially selected in the file chooser dialog.

modal.brief: Whether the file chooser dialog is modal.
modal.md: Whether the file chooser dialog is modal.

title.brief: A title that may be shown on the file chooser dialog.
title.md: A title that may be shown on the file chooser dialog.
